method.sqlite: Python sqlite3 read-only URI mode=ro plus PRAGMA query_only=ON
method.rowHash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON of SELECT * FROM datas ORDER BY id; JSON separators comma/colon, integer values retained exactly
method.scope: Local snapshots and checked-in source; not production runtime verification; no sensitive config read

sourceCatalogIsNotHistoricalWhitelist.detail: Catalog provides metadata and multilingual names. Full inputs include 630 Xyz, 399 Pendulum and 506 Link rows. ot bit 0x8 is AVAIL_SC in checked-in source, not a chronological exclusion flag.

canonicalSourceCandidate.detail: Local srvprotianti/ygopro/cards.cdb byte-identical to cards.zh.cdb. Server source loads cards.cdb then expansions; actual deployed working directory, binary and expansion load order are unverified.

categoryRepresentation.detail: This is a signed versus unsigned 32-bit representation difference, not a changed category bit mask. Raw row hashes still differ.

banlistSemantics.detail: Local parser accepts counts 0..2; absent IDs are subject to the general three-copy cap. Copy counting spans main, extra and side and uses get_duel_code(), including alias/rule_code normalization. Banlist alone does not enforce the historical release cutoff.

historicalPoolCutoff.detail: The ladder introduction specifies OCG cards released through 2011-08-31 and the March 2011 banlist. The banlist date must not be used as the card-pool cutoff.

emptyDescriptions.detail: Chinese blank description IDs 19144623 and 77571455 are both TYPE_TOKEN. Blank str1..str16 cells are not automatically missing translations.

javascriptIntegerPrecision.detail: Each source has four setcode values outside Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; preserve 64-bit values in build tooling and validate replay CardReader decoding without lossy JS Number conversion.
